# Charred cogwheel

Type: Material | Internal ID: CharredCogwheel | Source: Skugg | Usage: Building | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No

# Introduction

The Charred cogwheel is an item introduced in the Ashlands update and is used primarily to construct the Catapult.
They can only be teleported by using the Portal Stone, not the regular Portal.

## Availability

Dropped from the Skugg which can be found in Charred Fortresses.

### Building

• Catapult

Categorias: Materials, Can't be Teleported
